items.title: Netflix Launches First AI-Branded Content Recommendations Feature on TVs
items.excerpt: Netflix is introducing AI Discover, a new tab on its TV app that lets subscribers explore titles through AI-generated themes such as "Something Light" or "Scare Me", a test bed for conversational discovery.
items.rationale: New product launch: the biggest streamer puts AI-generated mood themes in front of viewers on TVs. Variety kept over the Verge copy of the same story (cluster c0).

items.title: Expression Sheet - Luma
items.excerpt: Luma launched Expression Sheet, a feature that lets creators explore the range of a character's facial performance across many expressions before committing to a direction.
items.rationale: New feature from the vendor itself (primary source). Gives AI filmmakers a way to control character performance, which they can use right away.

items.title: AI가 만든 '임권택 스타일' 영화 공개…대한민국예술원 영화전
items.excerpt: 대한민국예술원 영화전(11월 5~6일, 서울영화센터)에서 AI가 임권택 감독의 영화를 학습한 뒤 그 스타일로 연출한 단편 '확인'이 처음 공개된다. 중단편 AI 영화 우수작 8편도 상영한다.
items.rationale: New event: the first public screening of a short directed by AI trained on a master director's style, with a firm date (Nov 5-6). Raises authorship and style-rights questions. No og_image, so ax-media must source one.

items.title: Hallmark Fans Are Furious Over The Alleged Use Of AI In New Christmas Movie
items.excerpt: Viewers of Hallmark's new Christmas movie 'Adopting St. Nick' say its signs and props look AI-generated, which has set off a backlash over AI use in production design.
items.rationale: New audience backlash over AI-generated production-design assets. A warning for art departments about how quickly viewers spot AI props. The allegation is attributed to viewers, not confirmed.

items.title: “AI 영화의 벽은 생성 아닌 납품”… 무암, AI 하이브리드 제작 공정 공개
items.excerpt: Korean studio Muam (director Hyun Hae-ri) demoed at AI Film Festival Japan 2026 a hybrid pipeline that turns generative-AI shots into final-delivery film cuts: plates are split into live-action vs AI regions, and VFX/DI staff share compositing, colour and mastering specs from the generation stage to fix stuttering, edge aliasing and live-action/AI colour-texture mismatch for OTT QC. Principle: 'Film with AI, not by AI'.
items.rationale: Fresh (11-03) and immediately useful craft insight: how to get generative-AI shots through VFX/DI and OTT delivery QC. Covers the delivery side of the pipeline, which no earlier movies card did.
